subject.title: fix: keep yielded parent runs deferred until subagents settle

question: Should OpenClaw accept `deferred` as a public cron/run status plus the new plugin-facing lifecycle callback/SDK exports for yielded-parent handoffs?
rationale: The patch fixes a real lifecycle bug, but it expands public protocol/SDK/status contracts and changes delivery timing; automation cannot choose that compatibility direction without maintainer intent.

options.title: Accept after proof and rebase
options.body: Require the contributor to rebase onto current main, add Discord-visible and upgrade proof, then review the public `deferred`/SDK contract as the intended path.

options.title: Narrow the public surface
options.body: Ask for a smaller repair that keeps yielded-parent runtime behavior internal and avoids adding a new public cron status or SDK helper unless a later API proposal approves it.

options.title: Pause or split the branch
options.body: Close or pause this broad branch and keep narrower related issues/PRs for cron, subagent, and Discord behavior if maintainers do not want the combined compatibility change.

recommendation.title: Accept after proof and rebase
recommendation.body: Require the contributor to rebase onto current main, add Discord-visible and upgrade proof, then review the public `deferred`/SDK contract as the intended path.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent cron/protocol/agent-session work makes this the strongest available owner for the public status and lifecycle contract choice.
